title: Notify v1.0.22
releaseNotes:
- Formatted all notice publish dates and final deadlines into dd/MM/yyyy format across Dashboard, Notices, and Inbox
- Fixed notification inbox delete functionality with instant removal and persistent tombstone tracking
- Auto-prune and hide notifications older than 3 months (90 days) on both app and worker
- Added live official SITCOE Notifications XML RSS feed (https://www.sitcoe.ac.in/notification/feed/) and Exam Timetable feed to ensure real-time notice capture
- Ingested Winter Semester Examination 2026 Old Syllabus Backlog Laboratory Courses Form Filling circular
